## Case format
```json
{ "case_id": "PUB-01",
  "opening_balance_bdt": "350.00",
  "days": [ {"date": "2026-01-01", "units": 5}, {"date": "2026-01-02", "units": 4}, ... ],
  "recharges": [ {"date": "2026-01-03", "amount_bdt": "1000.00"}, ... ],
  "today": "2026-06-30", "usual_daily_units": 9, "target_date": "2026-07-25",
  "comparison": {"months": ["2026-04", "2026-05", "2026-06"], "source": "readings", "daily_units": null,
                 "opening_balance_bdt": "0.00", "low_threshold_bdt": "100.00",
                 "low_amount_bdt": "2000.00", "monthly_amount_bdt": "2000.00"} }
```
Readings are whole units per day, consecutive, starting on the 1st of a month (so the slab counter
starts at zero). `opening_balance_bdt` is the meter balance before the first day. `today` is the last
reading date. Item 4 runs on the three `comparison.months`: `source` `readings` uses the case's own
